description: This course explores the diverse modes of inquiry in the discipline of political science. Broadly centered around the question, "How do you know?," students focus on different methods of locating and collecting data, reviewing political texts and contested concepts, and constructing theoretical explanations of political phenomena. Offered each semester. Prerequisite: one previous course in department and a declared PSCI major. Non-majors may register with permission of instructor.
name: Analyzing Politics
notes: For Political Science majors only. Others may register with permission of the
